name: non-CIDR iteration carries forward to the global upper boundary
input: an address near the last IPv4 values

name: reverse iteration borrows through the global lower boundary
input: a low address without a CIDR suffix

name: CIDR bounds include /32 /31 and complete /29 blocks
a CIDR iterator starts at the supplied address and stops permanently
input: a middle address in a /29 block
test:
iterator = IPv4Iterator('192.0.2.13/29')
assert next(iterator) == '192.0.2.13'
assert next(iterator) == '192.0.2.14'
assert next(iterator) == '192.0.2.15'
try:
    next(iterator)
    raise AssertionError('expected StopIteration')
except StopIteration:
    pass
